scripts.emulator:start: npm run firebase:cli -- emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project demo-app-treino --only firestore
scripts.test:rules: npm run firebase:cli -- emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-app-treino --only firestore "npm run test:rules:inside"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:rules
